summary: Full LLM regression FAILED. Only 2/7 backend tests passed (provider-status + world-report). world-assets/storyboard/scene-prompts/scene-image consistently return 502 Bad Gateway from Cloudflare ingress because Claude Sonnet 4.5 responses exceed the ~60s edge timeout. Additionally, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget was hit mid-test ('Current cost: 0.4247045, Max budget: 0.4'), making some world-report calls fail 500 as well. As a consequence the per-scene reference-photo OVERRIDE system could NOT be verified end-to-end because you cannot reach the storyboard stage. UI code inspection confirms all new data-testids are wired correctly and effectiveRefIds/StoryboardSceneCard/SceneImageCard logic looks correct. The header 'IMAGE PROVIDER MISSING' false-positive from iteration_1 is confirmed FIXED.

critical.issue: Consistently returns 502 Bad Gateway (Cloudflare HTML page). Backend access log shows the request never completes within the ingress timeout (~60s). Claude Sonnet 4.5 with max_tokens=8192 emits ~15-18KB of JSON which takes 90-120s wall time. No FastAPI-level 502 (backend hasn't returned) — this is an infrastructure edge timeout.
Not reachable in this iteration because chain is blocked at world-assets; same long-latency Claude call pattern will 502 too.

Key sk-emergent-77256FeC9B137A93b6 is at $0.4247/$0.40. LiteLLM returns 'Budget has been exceeded!' 500 errors intermittently. Blocks any further LLM call. User must be given a new/topped-up key or Emergent Portal budget must be raised.
Works when budget allows (~50-57s per call). Also >50% of Cloudflare's expected timeout — a bad-luck-slow response could also 502.

minor.issue: Original strict json.loads failed for multi-KB Claude responses (unescaped newlines). Fixed in this run by adding json_repair fallback; world-report now robust. world-assets fix not verifiable due to gateway timeout.

integration_issues.issue: User cannot progress past Stage 03 (World Assets) because /api/generate-world-assets always returns 502. Toast shows a generic message but user is stuck. No client-side retry.

action_items: URGENT: Refresh / raise the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget (currently $0.4247 / $0.40).

Refactor /api/generate-world-assets: split into 3 SMALLER Claude calls (style_bible, character_sheet, environment_sheet), each <60s. Same for /generate-storyboard (maybe 2 calls of 4 scenes) and /generate-scene-prompts (chunked). This is required to survive the Cloudflare ~60s edge timeout of the preview host.
Alternatively, stream via SSE / websocket so the ingress doesn't kill the connection.
Consider lowering per-call output size: use max_tokens=4096 but tighten the JSON schema (fewer/shorter fields) OR ask Claude for very concise strings.
Add exponential-backoff retry in api.js for 5xx (currently zero retry).
Keep the json_repair fallback I added (already merged into server.py) — it hardens against occasional malformed JSON.
After budget + latency are fixed, re-run this exact pytest to verify overrides.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: All 4 Claude endpoints call Claude Sonnet 4.5 with max_tokens=8192 in a single blocking request. This exceeds the preview environment's ingress timeout for larger prompts. Chunking or streaming required.

ProjectWorkflow.jsx effectiveRefIds() correctly handles null/undefined/empty override lists and falls back to storyboard suggestions when overrides are cleared to []. StoryboardSceneCard toggles are wired to update reference_photo_overrides in project state. SceneImageCard reads activeRefs and shows '(Override)' or '(Suggested)' label correctly. All new data-testids are present.

api.js: generateSceneImage sends full imageDataUrl per ref photo (data URL). This can be several MB when the user uploads big photos. No client-side compression. If ingress body limit is <10MB, large ref sets will 413.
storage.js: All project state is localStorage-only. Large reference-photo data URLs can blow the ~5MB quota and silently fail — user only sees a toast. Consider IndexedDB for future.

server.py exception handler is registered for `Exception` which does NOT intercept HTTPException. That is correct behavior, but the client cannot distinguish a FastAPI-raised 502 from a Cloudflare ingress 502 — both render the Cloudflare HTML page in the preview environment.

rca_of_the_issue: PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE: The preview host's edge/ingress terminates HTTP responses that take longer than ~60 seconds. Claude Sonnet 4.5 responses for world-assets (~18KB JSON) take 90-120s wall clock, so the ingress returns a Cloudflare HTML 502 to the client while the backend is still waiting on Claude. Reproduction: run test_02_generate_world_assets in /app/backend/tests/test_beatvision_full_chain.py after a successful world-report — 100% failure rate observed 3 times. SECONDARY ROOT CAUSE: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap reached ($0.4247/$0.40), returning LiteLLM 'Budget has been exceeded!' which the backend surfaces as HTTP 500. Mitigation applied: added json_repair to _extract_json (server.py) so if Claude outputs malformed JSON we can still parse. Mitigation required from main agent: split large LLM endpoints into smaller sub-calls, and get budget refreshed.
